tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures indicate both sink-gradient dependence and coupled transient lag. The five pilot rows leave a genuine identifiability ambiguity; the fine trajectory batch is the available probe suited to resolving it.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a coupled transient siphon-memory model from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not adequately identify the coupled transient and sink-gradient parameters or distinguish competing mechanisms.
It is not targeted at the identified transient-model ambiguity.
